ruleName: Ball hits the flagstick or the person tending it
title: Flagstick Hit Accidentally – What Happens?
question: You're putting and your ball rolls into a flagstick lying beside the green after it was removed. What is the ruling?

choices.text: You get a penalty and must replay the stroke
There is no penalty, play the ball as it lies
Move the flagstick and replay the shot
Add two penalty strokes and continue

explanation: If your ball accidentally hits the flagstick after it has been properly removed and placed on the ground, there is no penalty. You play the ball as it lies.

juniorVersion.title: What if your ball bumps into the flagstick on the ground?
juniorVersion.question: You are putting and your ball rolls and hits the flagstick that is lying next to the green. What should you do?

choices.text: You get a penalty and have to take the putt again
You do not get a penalty. Play your ball from where it stopped
Pick up the flagstick and putt again
Add two shots to your score, then play on

juniorVersion.explanation: If your ball hits the flagstick lying on the ground by accident, you do not get a penalty. Just play your ball from wherever it stops.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The tall pole in the hole that shows you where the hole is on the green.
Play the ball from where it is now.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Let children practice putting when the flagstick is lying nearby, so they know what to do if their ball bumps it accidentally.
likelyMisconceptions: Some children may think they must take their shot again if their ball hits the flagstick.
Some might think they get a penalty or have to move the ball.
